title: DramaClaw: Free AI Video Engine – Script to Film in One Pipeline
description:
DramaClaw is a free, self-hosted AI video engine that turns a written script into a finished video automatically. It's an open-source alternative to Runway for generative video production. Run it on your own machine with one Docker command.
